records.algorithm_name: P1 历史种子计划的局部剖面改进

parameters.failure_policy: Stop case on first proposal or evaluator failure; retain E0-confirmed seed; promote only after final E0

timing.evaluation_precision: time.monotonic float seconds; display precision is not measurement accuracy

solver.method: Two-round local partition refinement of an existing guided-moves plan. Actual Task profiles prioritize split/cover-merge candidates; E1 selects and original E0 confirms. Not a general raw-graph solver.

measurement.solver_scope: Refinement from existing guided-moves seed only; excludes seed production. Supervisor includes process launch/reaping; function total starts inside refine(). Final E0 is within refinement.
measurement.evaluation_scope: Historical final E0 confirmation subprocess phase, measured by confirm() using time.monotonic; included in refinement stage. Export runs no evaluation.

budget.stop_reason: Two prescribed rounds completed; 8 new candidates plus one E1 seed score, final E0 confirmation succeeded.

measurement.offline_costs: Existing guided-moves seed generation and earlier search cost excluded and not aggregated here; no new training/compilation/benchmark performed by export.

missing_reasons.metrics.solver_wall_seconds: Full raw-graph-to-plan time absent; only refinement-stage time exists, excluding historical seed production.
missing_reasons.timing.solver_includes_evaluation: No complete solver wall is reported. Historical final E0 is included in the separately retained refinement-stage wall.
missing_reasons.timing.utc: Original receipts contain monotonic elapsed durations, no run UTC timestamps.
missing_reasons.provenance.runner.argv: Exact runtime argv was not retained; source constructs commands but this export does not fabricate an observed invocation.
missing_reasons.provenance.runner.working_directory: Actual inherited working directory was not recorded.
missing_reasons.provenance.environment.cpu: Original protocol records OS/architecture, not CPU model.
missing_reasons.provenance.environment.gpu: Original protocol does not record GPU or its absence.
missing_reasons.provenance.environment.ram_bytes: Machine RAM was not recorded; RSS budget is not machine RAM.
missing_reasons.provenance.environment.threads: Thread count was not recorded; workers=1 is not a thread count.
missing_reasons.provenance.measurement.started_at: No original UTC timestamp; Git timestamps and mtimes are not substituted.
missing_reasons.provenance.measurement.finished_at: No original UTC timestamp; Git timestamps and mtimes are not substituted.
missing_reasons.provenance.measurement.seed: This refinement uses deterministic priorities/ID ties and an existing plan, not an integer random seed.
missing_reasons.provenance.measurement.cold_start: Original run does not classify cold/warm start.

notes: Historical original attempt exported without rerun; run_id/attempt_id label the existing case receipt, not a new experiment.
repeat_index=0 denotes the sole receipt for this case in the original experiment's one-pass CASES loop, not a rerun or guessed timestamp.

solver_commit=909f6f1f29fc7f2557395fae98f0f68a853f4c4b identifies the exact archived as-run source path, not the post-run hardened src/q1/profile_refine.py. Runtime base HEAD was 95bca21e3bf211caf975652d82f7f4e331ec44cd with recorded source hashes.
Full solver wall, runtime UTC, CPU/RAM/GPU and cold/warm classification are unknown. Refinement-only wall remains in provenance-summary.json and must not populate solver_wall_seconds.
Original plan/result/run bytes copied unchanged; archive and payload hashes checked. This export is not an independent E0 rerun or scientific acceptance.
Historical counters include 2 complete E0 confirmations and 9 E1 calls; two additional local Task profile compilations are recorded separately.

Revision 2 adds the existing official singlecore denominator from 6664a63adc3464d28d1f835d907cdeaea23e6b35, after graph/config/official identity and result-byte hash checks. Same historical attempt; no new solver/evaluator call; metrics and unknown wall time unchanged.
